entry.title: Studying depressive symptoms after surgery
entry.summary: A two-year project aims to identify patients who may need additional support for depressive symptoms after surgery.

entry.title: U-M researchers aim to shorten the path to effective mental health care
entry.summary: COMPASS participants contribute repeated reports, genetic samples, and health record data to study why mental health treatment responses differ.

entry.title: Comparing cancer immunotherapy outcomes in Black and white patients
entry.summary: A study using Veterans Health Administration records compared survival and immune-related adverse events in Black and white patients receiving cancer immunotherapy.

entry.title: MGI 2024: Lars Fritsche
entry.summary: A U-M symposium talk by Lars Fritsche examines a decade of genetics research linked to electronic health records, with examples from PheWeb and PRSweb.

entry.title: U-M announces NIMH-backed COMPASS precision mental health grant
entry.summary: A $17.9 million NIMH award supports COMPASS, a collaboration studying differences in mental health treatment response.

entry.title: Comparing methods for evaluating COVID-19 booster effectiveness
entry.summary: A comparison of observational methods examined how study design and analysis choices affect estimates of COVID-19 booster effectiveness.

entry.title: Estimating the global prevalence of long COVID
entry.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis combined 50 studies to compare long COVID prevalence across regions, follow-up periods, and hospitalization status.

entry.title: Evaluating cancer polygenic risk scores across ancestry groups
entry.summary: Cancer polygenic risk scores were evaluated across ancestry groups in UK Biobank, highlighting the need for more diverse genetic studies.

entry.title: Democratizing genetic data for cancer research
entry.summary: Cancer PRSweb provides archived comparisons of cancer polygenic risk scores in the Michigan Genomics Initiative and UK Biobank.

entry.title: Genetic risk for abdominal aortic aneurysm
entry.summary: A genetic study in the Million Veteran Program identified regions associated with abdominal aortic aneurysm and evaluated a polygenic risk score.

entry.title: Max Salvatore on COVID-19 modeling in India
entry.summary: Max Salvatore reflects on his cancer research experience and subsequent work modeling COVID-19 in India.

entry.title: Eye expert leads research to better predict blindness in patients
entry.summary: An international collaboration combines clinical measures, retinal imaging, genetics, and machine learning to study progression of age-related macular degeneration.

entry.title: Evaluating cancer polygenic risk scores in the Michigan Genomics Initiative
entry.summary: Cancer polygenic risk scores were associated with diagnoses of cancers and related conditions in the Michigan Genomics Initiative.

entry.title: Common and rare genetic variants in age-related macular degeneration
entry.summary: An international study of about 43,000 people identified common and rare genetic variants associated with age-related macular degeneration.
